name: Inworld
shortDescription: Character AI for games and interactive agents.
longDescription: Inworld builds character AI for games and interactive experiences. The On-Demand plan is $0, then you pay as you go. Paid plans start at $25 per month.
pricingNotes: Paid usage samples also present, confirm free allotment.
freeTierNotes: On-Demand plan is $0, then pay as you go.

strength: The On-Demand plan is $0 to start, then you pay as you go for game character dialogue.
weakness: There is no flat monthly starting price, because usage is pay as you go after the $0 plan.
